title: Recovery tests
description: Paperclip's 12 connection recovery tests in `packages/db/src/postgres-connection-recovery.test.ts`: six disconnect scenarios, each through ESM and CommonJS. On the fork one line of their fixture is changed: after `release()` on a reserved connection that had already closed, the check expects `CONNECTION_RELEASED` instead of `CONNECTION_CLOSED`. The diff is in the fork job's `prepare.diff`.
